payload.displayName: M365 - CFG-WIN-003 - Windows Hello for Business
payload.description: Dedicated Hello policy covering enablement, PIN composition, lifetime and sign-in methods. The tenant enrolment setting must remain Not configured.

controls.documentationNotes: Reviewed 17 September 2026. Composition rules follow the CSP convention where a value of 1 requires the character class and 2 forbids it; lowercase, uppercase and special characters are therefore left unset, which permits them without requiring them. Maximum PIN length is unset because a maximum only constrains users who want a longer PIN. Expiration 0 is never, following Microsoft's guidance: the PIN is device-local and TPM-protected, so rotation mainly produces predictable increments and helpdesk calls. PIN history is omitted because it only acts when PINs expire. Phone sign-in, enhanced anti-spoofing and Enhanced Sign-in Security are deliberately not configured: the first is a retired feature, and the other two depend on specific hardware and silently disable biometrics on devices that lack it. Cloud Kerberos trust is not configured because this standard targets cloud-only tenants; a hybrid client needs it added deliberately. Biometrics and security-key settings are device-scoped and are not under the tenant node. Not yet accepted by a live tenant. PassportForWork complexity explicit values: 0 allowed, 1 required, 2 disallowed. Unconfigured defaults differ: digits required and lowercase disallowed in Microsoft prose. This recipe explicitly writes Digits=0 and LowercaseLetters=1; it does not rely on defaults.

throw 'Manual reference only: review one step with the guide preflight, before evidence and durable intent.'
# Use the delegated Graph preflight in this guide. Resolve all placeholders locally and preserve JSON types.
# The body below is the catalogue candidate. Creation is separate from activation/assignment.
$json = @'
{
  "@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.windows10CustomConfiguration",
  "displayName": "CFG - Remove consumer Copilot app",
  "description": "M365 BuildStandard CFG-WIN-021; review edition and prerequisites before assignment.",
  "omaSettings": [
    {
      "@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.omaSettingInteger",
      "displayName": "Remove consumer Copilot app",
      "omaUri": "./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/WindowsAI/RemoveMicrosoftCopilotApp",
      "value": 1
    }
  ]
}
'@
if ($json -match '\{\{[^}]+\}\}') { throw 'Resolve every named client input first; do not send placeholders.' }
$body = $json | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable
if ($body.ContainsKey('assignments')) { throw 'Creation must remain unassigned.' }
# Inspect existing objects and any name conflict before creation. A matching name is never permission to update/adopt.
Assert-ManualGraphTenant
$created = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations' -Body ($body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50) -ContentType 'application/json' -ErrorAction Stop
# Record the returned ID immediately. If the request is uncertain, stop and reconcile; do not send it again.
if (-not $created.id) { throw 'Returned ID unknown; reconcile without retrying creation.' }
Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method GET -Uri ('https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations/' + $created.id) -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50
Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method GET -Uri ('https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations/' + $created.id + '/assignments') -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30
# Pass for a new candidate: no assignments. Never add an assignment as part of creation.
